notes.title: You can play multiplayer!! Badminton Kings VR - Update #2.0
notes.content:
Hello. fans. Long time no see!

In response to your feedback, Badminton kings VR has been updated for a more pleasant experience. 


[h1] 
Improvements and updates
[/h1]

[quote] 
[list]
    [*] Right-hand / left-hand type, controller vibration on / off can be selected.

    [*]  You can choose graphic quality (Up, Middle, Lower).

    [*] You can adjust the background sound, voice sound, and effect sound.

    [*] A setting window for adjustment has been added to the upper left corner of the main menu.

    [*] Multiplayer is possible. Two players can play the game on a turn-based basis.

    [*] Multiplayer can make a room and play with friends.

    [*]Ranking added. However, the ranking starts from next season.

[/list]


[/quote]


thank you!

You can adjust the background sound, voice sound, and effect sound.
A setting window for adjustment has been added to the upper left corner of the main menu.
Multiplayer is possible. Two players can play the game on a turn-based basis.
Multiplayer can make a room and play with friends.
Ranking added. However, the ranking starts from next season.

notes.title: Badminton Kings VR - Beta Update #1.02
notes.content:
Dear fans.


we're getting bug fixes by receiving your feedback.

BUG FIXED

Fixed a bug where you get an unconditional score when hit on the net.

notes.title: Badminton Kings VR - Beta Update #1.01
notes.content:
Dear fans

we would like to thank you for the feedback we have gathered from the beta phase.Your feedback has been a great help.

BUG FIXES

A frame drop in PingPong Kings VR has also been found in this gmae. so Fixed a problem that the frame dropped suddenly when the game was executed. You can play in a slightly more pleasant environment.
